Not every tattoo needs to be bold to be beautiful.

These fine line jellyfish by Karan prove it. Soft dotwork shading, flowing tentacles, a quiet ocean feeling that sits gently on the skin. Delicate, detailed, and designed to age clean.

If fine line or minimalist ocean tattoos are your thing, come talk to us at Ace Tattooz Andheri West.

Har Har Mahadev. 🔱

A custom trishul forearm piece by Karan, carrying every element that defines Shiva. 

The damru that beats the rhythm of creation. The rudraksha that grounds. The lotus that rises. A temple scene at the base.

This is fully custom devotional work, drawn from scratch at Ace Tattooz Andheri West, Veera Desai Road.

The trishul destroys what no longer serves. The rudraksha grounds. The Om vibrates at the frequency the universe started from. The lotus carries the whole journey upward.

Every element in this custom Mahadev tattoo was placed with a reason. 

Every line was drawn with care. That is the only way a devotional tattoo earns its place on skin.

Ace Tattooz Andheri West, Veera Desai Road.

Matching tattoos are one of the most personal things two people can do together. 

They deserve to be done with the same care as any individual piece.
Mahima Bhanushali did these matching daisy wrist tattoos in one session. 

Both wrists, identical execution, zero shortcuts.

If you have been told colour tattoos do not age well, you have probably seen colour tattoos done without enough depth in the ink application.

This multi-flower colour bouquet by Mahima Bhanushali shows what the style looks like when it is done properly. 

Pink, blue, yellow, green. Each colour built to last.

Some tattoos photograph well. Some look even better in person. This watercolour lotus by Archana Nakhua Bhanushali is both.

The colour layering inside the petals catches light differently at different times of day. 

On the forearm it becomes something you notice in your own reflection and remember why you got it.

The back is the largest canvas on the human body. 

This is what happens when you use it properly.

Ornamental lotus back tattoo by Mahima Bhanushali at Ace Tattooz. Lotus at the top, mandala wings across the shoulders, ornamental detail all the way down to the spine tip.

A dog portrait tattoo lives or dies by the expression in the eyes. Get that wrong and no amount of detail in the fur or the background saves it.

Karan Bhanushali got it right. The Golden Retriever in this piece has a specific look. Alert, warm, happy. 

The fine line botanical frame around it adds context without pulling focus from the portrait. 

Rose, leaves, botanical detail work. Simple composition, very precise execution.

Ace Tattooz Andheri West, Veera Desai Road.

Custom sports tattoos are one of those categories that almost always get done badly. A generic racket, a football, a bat. Something that looks like clip art printed on skin.

This is not that. Karan Bhanushali at our studio built a full abstract composition around tennis. 

The movement, the impact, the feeling of the sport. It reads as dynamic from across the room and as detailed up close.

Ace Tattooz Andheri West, Veera Desai Road.

The Om sits at the centre in red. 

Everything else in this mandala radiates outward from it in black and grey. 

Petal layers, dot work, trishul patterns, geometric border work that wraps clean around the elbow.

Mahima Bhanushali did this across two sessions at our studio and the level of consistency between day one and day two is exactly what separates experienced mandala artists from everyone else.

Ace Tattooz Andheri West, Veera Desai Road.
